
## Installing

Download the zip for your computer below (Windows or Linux), unzip it, and copy the `Paragon PR7-V.vst3` folder into your VST3 folder. Close your DAW first if you're replacing an older version.

| OS | VST3 folder |
|---|---|
| Windows | `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3` |
| Linux | `~/.vst3` |

Then rescan plugins in your DAW. Your rigs are kept between versions.
